tokens.name: neutral-0
tokens.usage: Pure white. Elevated card fill in light mode (via bg-1); text on filled accents. Raw ramp step: prefer the semantic bg-/fg-/border tokens in UI.

tokens.name: neutral-50
tokens.usage: Paper. Page surface in light mode (via bg-0); text on dark in the inverse role. Raw ramp step: prefer the semantic bg-/fg-/border tokens in UI.

tokens.name: neutral-100
tokens.usage: Light neutral ramp step. Raw ramp step: prefer the semantic bg-/fg-/border tokens in UI.

tokens.name: neutral-200
tokens.usage: Default hairline in light mode (via border). Raw ramp step: prefer the semantic bg-/fg-/border tokens in UI.

tokens.name: neutral-300
tokens.usage: Strong hairline in light mode (via border-strong); toggle track when off. Raw ramp step: prefer the semantic bg-/fg-/border tokens in UI.

tokens.name: neutral-400
tokens.usage: Disabled text in light mode; secondary text in dark mode. Raw ramp step: prefer the semantic bg-/fg-/border tokens in UI.

tokens.name: neutral-500
tokens.usage: Secondary-button hover border and mid-grey graphics. Tertiary text now uses fg-3, which is slightly darker. Raw ramp step: prefer the semantic bg-/fg-/border tokens in UI.

tokens.name: neutral-600
tokens.usage: Secondary text in light mode (via fg-2). Raw ramp step: prefer the semantic bg-/fg-/border tokens in UI.

tokens.name: neutral-700
tokens.usage: Pressed surface in dark mode (via bg-3); strong hairline in dark. Raw ramp step: prefer the semantic bg-/fg-/border tokens in UI.

tokens.name: neutral-800
tokens.usage: Default text in light mode (via fg-1); hovered surface in dark. Raw ramp step: prefer the semantic bg-/fg-/border tokens in UI.

tokens.name: neutral-900
tokens.usage: Elevated card fill in dark mode (via bg-1). Raw ramp step: prefer the semantic bg-/fg-/border tokens in UI.

tokens.name: neutral-1000
tokens.usage: Ink. Primary text in light mode; page surface in dark mode. Raw ramp step: prefer the semantic bg-/fg-/border tokens in UI.

tokens.name: brand-green
tokens.usage: Signal Green, the brand's identity colour: the logomark's eye, the wordmark dot, illustrations, the cover, the first data-viz series and marketing accents. UI fills and indicators use action-primary and control-accent instead, because white on Signal Green is only 3.05:1.

tokens.name: brand-green-hover
tokens.usage: A deeper Signal Green (white 4.35:1). Also the marquee stroke in light. Buttons now hover on action-primary-hover.

tokens.name: brand-green-press
tokens.usage: The deepest brand green: action-primary-hover, and the brand ink in light mode (6.53:1 on white, 5.67:1 on brand-green-soft).

tokens.name: brand-green-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted brand background: brand badges, focus halo around inputs, highlighted diagram nodes.

tokens.name: brand-green-ink
tokens.usage: Brand green as text: eyebrow labels, toast actions and the active chip label. Press green in light (6.5:1 on white, 5.67:1 on brand-green-soft); Signal Green in dark (6.5:1 on ink).

tokens.name: action-primary
tokens.usage: Filled surfaces that carry white text: primary and split buttons, FAB, selected calendar day, count badges, avatars. White on it is 4.81:1 (passes AA for 14px labels); on paper it is 4.6:1.

tokens.name: action-primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for action-primary surfaces (white 6.53:1).

tokens.name: action-primary-press
tokens.usage: Pressed fill for action-primary surfaces (white 8.96:1). Darker, never smaller.

tokens.name: control-accent
tokens.usage: Checked, on and selected indicators: checkbox and radio fills, toggles, slider fill, tab underlines, active outlines, focused field borders. 4.6:1 on paper in light, 6.5:1 on ink in dark (both above the 3:1 needed for UI indicators).

tokens.name: accent-cyan
tokens.usage: Signal Cyan: info state and links in body copy; second data-viz series. 2.74:1 on paper: use for large text, icons or fills rather than small body text.

tokens.name: accent-cyan-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted cyan background for info badges.

tokens.name: accent-cyan-ink
tokens.usage: Cyan as text: info badges, info tags and links on light surfaces. 5.28:1 on accent-cyan-soft and 6.12:1 on white in light; 7.17:1 on its soft tint in dark.

tokens.name: accent-plum
tokens.usage: Signal Plum: 'live' indicators and the success glyph in toasts; third data-viz series.

tokens.name: accent-plum-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted plum background.

tokens.name: accent-plum-ink
tokens.usage: Plum as text on accent-plum-soft: 6.32:1 in light, 6.96:1 in dark.

tokens.name: state-success
tokens.usage: Success text and dots. On state-success-soft it measures 3.49:1 (light) and 3.6:1 (dark), both below 4.5:1 for 11px badge text; flagged.

tokens.name: state-success-soft
tokens.usage: Success badge background.

tokens.name: state-success-ink
tokens.usage: Success text: badges, tags, accepted statuses. 5.61:1 on state-success-soft in light (6.47:1 on white); 6.88:1 in dark. Keep state-success for dots, icons and fills.

tokens.name: state-warning
tokens.usage: Warning fills, dots and the fifth data-viz series. Not for text on light surfaces (2.85:1); use state-warning-ink.

tokens.name: state-warning-ink
tokens.usage: Warning text: badges, status items. 4.81:1 on state-warning-soft in light; 6.85:1 on its soft tint in dark.

tokens.name: state-warning-soft
tokens.usage: Warning badge background.

tokens.name: state-danger
tokens.usage: Destructive borders, error icons, the input error border and danger fills. Text on the page or on the soft tint uses state-danger-ink.

tokens.name: state-danger-soft
tokens.usage: Danger badge background and danger button hover.

tokens.name: state-danger-ink
tokens.usage: Danger text in both themes: danger button labels, destructive menu items, danger badges and error help text. 6.4:1 on paper and 5.5:1 on its soft tint in light; 8.2:1 on ink and 6.5:1 on its soft tint in dark.

tokens.name: state-info
tokens.usage: Info state. Alias of accent-cyan.

tokens.name: state-info-soft
tokens.usage: Info badge background. Alias of accent-cyan-soft.

tokens.name: bg-0
tokens.usage: Page surface. Paper in light, ink in dark.

tokens.name: bg-1
tokens.usage: Elevated surface: cards, inputs, menus, secondary buttons.

tokens.name: bg-2
tokens.usage: Hovered surface. Deepened in light mode so the hover step reads clearly against bg-0/bg-1 (a bare neutral-100 was near-invisible). Also segmented-control track and inline code.

tokens.name: bg-3
tokens.usage: Pressed or selected surface (deeper than bg-2 hover). Press changes colour, never size.

tokens.name: bg-inverse
tokens.usage: Inverse surface for high-contrast moments.

tokens.name: fg-0
tokens.usage: Primary text: headings, titles, input values.

tokens.name: fg-1
tokens.usage: Default body text on bg-0 and bg-1.

tokens.name: fg-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels and default icon colour (6.38:1 light, 9.43:1 dark).

tokens.name: fg-3
tokens.usage: Tertiary text, placeholders, metadata, keyboard hints. Passes 4.5:1 on every surface it sits on: 4.8:1 on paper, 5.0:1 on white and 4.55:1 on bg-2 in light; 5.9:1 on ink and 4.8:1 on bg-2 in dark.

tokens.name: fg-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled text.

tokens.name: fg-on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand-green and other filled accents.

tokens.name: fg-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on bg-inverse.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Default 1px hairline: dividers, card edges, menus.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Stronger 1px hairline: input borders, secondary buttons, card hover.

tokens.name: border-focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: an outline of focus-ring-width at focus-ring-offset. Follows control-accent: 4.6:1 on paper, 6.5:1 on ink.

tokens.name: surface-selected
tokens.usage: Fill for the selected row in lists, trees, sidebars and combo popups. Hover stays on bg-2, so hover and selection never share a step.

tokens.name: canvas-bg
tokens.usage: Drawing-paper background behind the diagram and capability-map surface. A hair off bg-0 (1.06:1) so the paper reads as a workspace.

tokens.name: canvas-grid-dot
tokens.usage: Dots of the 24px canvas grid (1px radius). About 1.35:1 on canvas-bg in both themes: visible, never louder than the content.

tokens.name: selection-marquee-fill
tokens.usage: Fill of the rubber-band rectangle when drag-selecting on the canvas.

tokens.name: selection-marquee-stroke
tokens.usage: 1px stroke of the drag-select rectangle (4.1:1 on canvas-bg in light).

tokens.name: text-selection-bg
tokens.usage: Highlight behind selected text in inputs, the code editor and prose.

tokens.name: text-selection-fg
tokens.usage: Text over text-selection-bg: 14.66:1 in light, 7.47:1 in dark.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Modal overlay behind dialogs and the command palette.

families.sans: "Inter Tight", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Atlas keeps your capability map, ADRs, and service graph in the same place.
styles.usage: Default body copy in fg-1. Slightly denser than the usual SaaS default, on purpose.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Used in dense UI: helper text, table cells, sidebar metadata.

styles.name: body-serif
styles.sample: For long-form prose. The manifesto, docs articles, pull quotes.
styles.usage: Long-form and editorial prose only. Use sparingly.

styles.name: ui-label
styles.usage: Labels of interactive controls: buttons (md and lg use 14 and 15px), split buttons and FAB. Sentence case, no tracking.

styles.name: ui-label-sm
styles.usage: Menu items, list options, tabs, nav and tree rows. The active or selected item steps up to weight 500.

styles.name: ui-caption
styles.usage: Field labels, help text and segmented-control labels (weight 500 there).

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code blocks and inline code, on bg-2 with radius-xs.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrow labels. Set in uppercase (text-transform), colour fg-2. The only place ALL CAPS is allowed.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps: icon to text inside a chip.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight gaps between related items.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gaps between form fields and within toolbars.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Compact card padding; list item gaps.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Default card padding; 12-column gutter; dotted-grid pitch.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gaps between groups.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Section padding in the app.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Marketing band spacing.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Large marketing section spacing.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Hero-scale spacing.

radius.note: Radii cap at 14px. No 16, 20 or 24px radii: larger reads as consumer and off-brand.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Truly square corners: full-bleed panels, table cells, canvas edges and anything butted against another edge.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Code blocks and tag chips (badges) only.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Segmented-control segments and small inner elements.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Default UI: inputs, buttons, menu items.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, menus, modals, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Marketing-scale cards. Also capsule toolbars (12px in the source prose; the nearest token is 14px).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills: filter chips, avatars, toggles.

shadow.note: Shadows are rare and small. No glows, coloured shadows or inner shadows.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Raised inputs in dense layouts, the selected segment, draggable cards.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus, command palette, capsules.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Modals only.

fontSize.note: The raw type scale. Type styles above compose these.

tokens.name: text-xs
tokens.usage: Eyebrow labels, badges, captions.

tokens.name: text-sm
tokens.usage: Dense UI copy, menu items, tabs.

tokens.name: text-base
tokens.usage: Default body.

tokens.name: text-md
tokens.usage: h4 and serif prose.

tokens.name: text-lg
tokens.usage: Lead paragraphs.

tokens.name: text-4xl
tokens.usage: display-2.

tokens.name: text-5xl
tokens.usage: display-1.

tokens.name: leading-tight
tokens.usage: Display and h1.

tokens.name: leading-snug
tokens.usage: h2 to h4.

tokens.name: leading-normal
tokens.usage: Body copy.

tokens.name: leading-relaxed
tokens.usage: Serif long-form.

tokens.name: tracking-display
tokens.usage: Anything over 32px.

tokens.name: tracking-tight
tokens.usage: h2 and h3.

tokens.name: tracking-normal
tokens.usage: Body.

tokens.name: tracking-label
tokens.usage: ALL-CAPS mono eyebrow labels.

tokens.name: weight-regular
tokens.usage: Body.

tokens.name: weight-medium
tokens.usage: Buttons, labels, active tabs.

tokens.name: weight-semibold
tokens.usage: Headings and titles.

tokens.name: weight-bold
tokens.usage: The wordmark (mono) only.

tokens.name: max-content
tokens.usage: Marketing max content width.

tokens.name: nav-height
tokens.usage: Fixed marketing top nav height.

density.note: Density steps, like Material's density scale. Set data-density on any ancestor; components add the step (--pl-d) to control-h-default and row-h-default.

tokens.name: density-touch
tokens.usage: data-density="touch": 44px controls, 40px rows. Meets the 44px touch target. Tablets, kiosks and touch-first surfaces.

tokens.name: density-comfortable
tokens.usage: The default: 36px controls, 32px rows.

tokens.name: density-compact
tokens.usage: data-density="compact": 32px controls, 28px rows. Busy app screens and side panels.

tokens.name: density-dense
tokens.usage: data-density="dense": 28px controls, 24px rows. Property grids, trees and tables for expert users.

sizing.note: Control and row heights per density level. Components read the live value through --pl-h and --pl-row.

tokens.name: control-h-dense
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs and pickers at dense.

tokens.name: control-h-compact
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs and pickers at compact.

tokens.name: control-h-default
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs and pickers at comfortable (the default). The base the density step is added to.

tokens.name: control-h-touch
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs and pickers at touch.

tokens.name: row-h-dense
tokens.usage: Menu, list, nav and combo-popup rows at dense (trees and property grids go 4px tighter).

tokens.name: row-h-compact
tokens.usage: Rows at compact.

tokens.name: row-h-default
tokens.usage: Rows at comfortable (the default). The base the density step is added to.

tokens.name: row-h-touch
tokens.usage: Rows at touch.

duration.note: All durations drop to 0ms under prefers-reduced-motion (bundle.css does this; custom code must honour it too).

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, focus and press state changes.

tokens.name: duration-medium
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, tooltips and small layout shifts.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Page-level transitions, drawers and sheets. Never longer.

tokens.name: easing-standard
tokens.usage: The default: a strong out-curve for almost everything. Enter and exit with opacity plus a 4px translate.

tokens.name: easing-inout
tokens.usage: Looping or symmetrical motion, such as indeterminate progress.

opacity.note: Disabled model: the whole control (fill, border, label, icon) is dimmed with one opacity, and the cursor becomes not-allowed. Use fg-disabled only for disabled text that sits outside a control, such as a list option or calendar day.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Applied to the entire disabled control. Disabled controls need no contrast minimum (WCAG exempts them), but the label must stay legible.

focus.note: The focus ring: an outline in border-focus, never a shadow, always visible on keyboard focus.

tokens.name: focus-ring-width
tokens.usage: Outline width of every focus ring. The only 2px line in the system.

tokens.name: focus-ring-offset
tokens.usage: Gap between the control and its ring. Use -2px inside clipped containers (splitter handles, table cells).
